title: pkix-chain-simple Error missing serde feature
description:
pkix-chain-simple::Error derives `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq` but has no `serde` Cargo feature and no `#[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]`. Its sibling pkix-chain::Error (which serves the same role for the full-featured verifier) has serde support behind a feature flag.

AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 states that public result/error types 'SHOULD support serde::Serialize + Deserialize behind a serde feature flag.' pkix-chain-simple::Error wraps pkix_path::Error (which has serde) but the wrapper itself does not.

Impact: callers using pkix-chain-simple who want to cache or serialize verification failures hit a wall when trying to serde-roundtrip pkix_chain_simple::Error. The Error wraps pkix_path::Error (which IS serde-able), but the outer enum is not.

Also missing: Send + Sync compile-time assertion. Every other substantive crate in the validation stack (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-aia, pkix-truststore, pkix-lint) has a `const _: fn() = || { fn _assert_send_sync<T: Send + Sync>() {} ... }` block. pkix-chain-simple does not.

Locations: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain-simple/Cargo.toml (no serde feature), /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs line 268-270 (Error derives)
